# Velytra

> Velytra is a multisport training and coaching platform. This site presents the public brand, core product positioning, and launch information.

Canonical site: https://www.velytra.org/
Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Languages
- [English (default)](https://www.velytra.org/)
- [Català](https://www.velytra.org/ca/)
- [Español](https://www.velytra.org/es/)

## Key pages
- [Home (EN)](https://www.velytra.org/): Main landing page
- [Functionalities](https://www.velytra.org/ca/funcionalitats/): Platform capabilities
- [Athletes](https://www.velytra.org/ca/atletes/): Athlete experience
- [Coaches](https://www.velytra.org/ca/entrenadors/): Coach workflows
- [FAQ](https://www.velytra.org/ca/faq/): Frequently asked questions
- [Download](https://www.velytra.org/ca/descarrega/): Mobile app downloads
- [Contact](https://www.velytra.org/ca/contacte/): Contact details
- [Privacy](https://www.velytra.org/ca/privacitat/): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://www.velytra.org/ca/termes/): Terms of use
